event_summary: A suspended ball on the left swings into a row of shiny balls, after which the right-end ball swings outward and the motion repeats back and forth.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a Newton's-cradle-like object on a tabletop. At the start, one shiny ball at the left is displaced leftward on an angled string while several other shiny balls hang close together near the center. The left ball moves rightward into the clustered balls. After contact with the cluster, a ball at the right side moves outward to the right, then returns toward the cluster. The visible motion repeats with alternating outward swings on the left and right sides while the central balls mostly remain grouped.

reasons: The suspended shiny balls, strings, frame, and base are visible.
One left-side ball is visibly offset from the grouped balls before the main motion.
The tabletop and surrounding stationary objects are visible.
